name: scout-portfolio
default_behavior: synthetic fixture with no network request
primary_host: Claude Code plugin from the gabchess/scout-onchain GitHub marketplace
fallback_hosts: Codex skills plugin with a uvx stdio MCP route pinned to a git tag
Cursor or any stdio MCP client through uvx pinned to a git tag
Plain Python through uvx or pipx

optional_integration.name: Zerion API
authorization: x402 pay-per-call (USDC on Base, bounded per payment and process)
optional_integration.scope: portfolio analytics from per-asset positions and mapped transaction history for one wallet across Zerion-supported chains, including Arc

known_limits: Synthetic fixture is not live data.
API-backed observations depend on endpoint access, authorization, freshness, and availability.
x402 budget reservations are conservative and reset with the process.
No live paid x402 request is verified by this repository.
Arc reads are tested offline with a Zerion-shaped fixture; no live Arc call is recorded.
Unsigned Zerion CLI preparation on Arc is tested offline; Zerion's live Arc chain flags and chain id are unverified.
x402 needs SCOUT_ENABLE_X402=1; x402 setups from 0.6.x without it read the fixture or API-key mode.
TypeSafe DCA intent resolution is tested offline with synthesized responses; no live TypeSafe call and no jev-1.12 availability are verified.
Codex starting the root .mcp.json and Cursor install are unverified.
No production SLA or Zerion endorsement is claimed.
evidence_boundary: This manifest describes source identity, package boundaries, and local build records. It does not prove publication, live provider behavior, security on an installer's machine, or data freshness.
release_artifact_policy: The local builder adds an entry after creating a verified ZIP. A build record is not publication evidence.
